He has weighed me down with chains
Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer
He has made my paths crooked
He is a bear lying in wait
I am a laughingstock to all my people; they mock me in song all day long
My soul has been deprived of peace
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD
to the soul who seeks Him
Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it upon him
bury his face in the dust
For the Lord will not cast us off forever
Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion
from the mouth of the Most High

until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees
dropped me alive into a pit

evidence.text: So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.”
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
“The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it upon him.
Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.

matchReviews.senseReview: Only literal uppercase LORD is admitted globally. Source Lord article explicitly covers God as Lord; lowercase human lord and sentence-title Lord are not inferred from this rule.

The author speaks of the suffering of Judah and Jerusalem as his own.
Some understand these verses as a poetic reference to Jeremiah’s confinement in a muddy cistern before the destruction of Jerusalem (
blocked my way . . . made my road crooked:
Sin causes confusion and cuts a person or a community off from a happy future. Innocent people know the future as a straight path that is easy to follow (
). Isaiah imagined God’s activities as a procession on a straight road that his worshipers would prepare (
Cp.

(or

): Wormwood is a plant with a bitter taste; here it represents the emotional intensity of inner agony (
). Gall is a poisonous plant that causes severe physical pain if eaten; it is a powerful symbol for extremely stressful emotions (
). The author seems to be at a dead end from which he cannot escape.
God’s love and faithfulness
never cease
. Just as God had been faithful in bringing judgment on Jerusalem for their sins, he would be faithful in bringing restoration to those who returned to him.
The
faithful love of the
Lord
is the basis for the poet’s recovery from deep depression. As with Jeremiah in the cistern (

God’s
faithfulness
speaks of his absolute reliability, which is evident in his daily
mercies
